e.title: Ballerine
e.summary: 开源风险决策引擎（2427★）：核保/入驻决策编排——规则+AI 双引擎，KYB/KYC/保险承保
e.body: Ballerine（ballerine-io/ballerine，2427★）是开源的风险决策（risk decisioning）基础设施：把核保/入驻（onboarding）决策编排为可视化工作流——规则引擎 + 数据源 + AI 模型组合（KYB/KYC 核查、欺诈检测、信用评估、保险承保），事件驱动、可审计。对 RIAA：保险核保/客户入驻的决策引擎参考（规则+AI 混合）——与 [[underwriting-workbench]]（证据优先核保）、[[higson-motor-insurance-demo]]（规则引擎演示）互补；决策可审计性与 [[insurance-mrm]]（模型风险管理）衔接；开源基础设施与 [[claimpilot-harness]] 同类。
e.verified_note: repo 页核实：开源风险决策编排平台（规则+AI，核保/入驻），2427★
e.summary_en: Open-source risk-decisioning engine (2427★): underwriting/onboarding decision orchestration — rules + AI dual engine, KYB/KYC/insurance
e.summary_hk: 開源風險決策引擎（2427★）：核保/入駐決策編排——規則+AI 雙引擎，KYB/KYC/保險承保
e.body_en: Ballerine (ballerine-io/ballerine, 2427★) is open-source risk-decisioning infrastructure: it orchestrates underwriting/onboarding decisions as visual workflows — combining a rules engine, data sources and AI models (KYB/KYC checks, fraud detection, credit assessment, insurance underwriting), event-driven and auditable. For RIAA: a decision-engine reference for insurance underwriting/customer onboarding (rules + AI hybrid) — complements [[underwriting-workbench]] (evidence-first underwriting) and [[higson-motor-insurance-demo]] (rules-engine demo); the auditable decisions connect to [[insurance-mrm]] (model risk management); open-source infrastructure in the same family as [[claimpilot-harness]].
e.body_hk: Ballerine（ballerine-io/ballerine，2427★）是開源的風險決策（risk decisioning）基礎設施：把核保/入駐（onboarding）決策編排為可視化工作流——規則引擎 + 數據源 + AI 模型組合（KYB/KYC 核查、欺詐檢測、信用評估、保險承保），事件驅動、可審計。對 RIAA：保險核保/客戶入駐的決策引擎參考（規則+AI 混合）——與 [[underwriting-workbench]]（證據優先核保）、[[higson-motor-insurance-demo]]（規則引擎演示）互補；決策可審計性與 [[insurance-mrm]]（模型風險管理）銜接；開源基礎設施與 [[claimpilot-harness]] 同類。
